title: Essential Tweaks and more mods count for fair play
summary: Running Essential Tweaks alongside Essential no longer puts your run in Free Play. A batch of recently approved mods now also count offline, from your very first launch.
highlights: Essential Tweaks approved for fair play
Armor Visibility now counts, it was approved under the wrong name before
Shoulder Surfing, Legendary Tooltips, Just Enough Characters, Armor HUD, Cubes Without Borders, Explosive Enhancement, Weapon Master and Cinematic Interactions are approved offline too
